name: capture-binding-pattern-test-cbcddb7fc4/capture-binding-pattern-v.bal

reason: The case requires match capture binding patterns, including named captures with guards and list/mapping binding patterns. These exceed the explicit restriction to constant and wildcard match patterns, so the whole case is a feature request.

List and mapping match binding patterns: var [a, b] and var {a: x, b: y}
